## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
sum(last_1h):sum:datadog.estimated_usage.logs.ingested_events{__SCOPE__,security_relevant:true} by {log_source}.as_count() < 1
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** Absence of log delivery is binary. A silent security log source is a compliance failure and a blind spot: the control has effectively been removed even though no customer sees it.

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-security-telemetry`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-security-control` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `control_last_success`, `source_agent_state`, `related_signals`.

Attached to the alert automatically: last successful control run, agent state, related Cloud SIEM signals.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `security` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `security-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P2, P3 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
